# Vendored libraries (offline)

These files are copied unmodified from npm so Spring Lens needs no `npm install` and no internet access.

| Library | Version | File | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| mermaid | 10.9.1 | mermaid/mermaid.min.js | MIT (mermaid/LICENSE) |
| cytoscape | 3.30.2 | cytoscape/cytoscape.min.js | MIT (cytoscape/LICENSE) |
| dagre | 0.8.5 | dagre/dagre.min.js | MIT (dagre/LICENSE) |
| cytoscape-dagre | 2.5.0 | cytoscape-dagre/cytoscape-dagre.js | MIT (cytoscape-dagre/LICENSE) |
| js-yaml | 4.1.0 | js-yaml/js-yaml.js | MIT (js-yaml/LICENSE) |

To upgrade: on a machine with internet, `npm pack <name>@<version>`, extract, and copy the same file over.
